criteria.statement: cloudfront-response-headers.mjs exports a pure transform producing the five header values verbatim with no Content-Security-Policy key
A unit test asserts all five header values verbatim, the camera=(self) grant specifically, and that no CSP header is produced
The idempotency check is unit-tested for both the already-attached and needs-attach cases
The attach transform changes only ResponseHeadersPolicyId, leaving Aliases, ViewerCertificate, FunctionAssociations, and CustomErrorResponses byte-identical
scripts/aws-bootstrap.sh creates/updates the response headers policy and idempotently attaches it in the custom-domain block
docs/aws/deployment.md's Custom domain section reads six idempotent steps with the response headers policy as step 6
